James and Mary Ford, eds.  Every Day in the Year.  1902.

June 11

On Sir Kenelm Digby

By Anonymous

Sir Kenelm Digby, who died on June 11th, 1665, was an English philosopher and student of the natural sciences. He was a royalist and became chancellor to Queen Henrietta Maria.
B
ORN
 on the day he died, the eleventh of June;
And that day bravely fought at Scanderoon.
How rare that one and the same day should be
His day of birth, of death, and victory.
